'''Dibra Born''' was an individual who served as the [[President/Legends|President]] of [[Sermeria]] and a noble of the [[Sermerian First House]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a suspicious package arrived at the House's government building in [[Addolis]], the planet's capital. It was presented to both Born and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]] and it was decidedly dangerous, so the government was forced to shut down for a time while a bomb squad and the [[Sermerian Bio-League]] contained the threat.
